meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 做任何 git 操作时,Claude 会先判断这是提交、变基还是查历史,再按仓库已有的提交风格把改动拆成多个原子提交,并先输出风格分析和提交计划。
howto.when: 当你提到 commit、rebase/squash,或问某行代码是谁写的、何时加入时触发;任何 git 操作都会被接管。

say.text: 把这些改动提交,拆成多个原子提交

howto.what_en: For any git task Claude first detects whether it's a commit, rebase/squash, or history lookup, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits matching the repo's existing commit style, printing a style analysis and commit plan first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention commit, rebase/squash, or ask who wrote a line or when something was added; any git operation is taken over.

say_en.text: Commit these changes as multiple atomic commits
say_en.note: Prints style analysis and plan first
